title: How can we make ten expressions with the same value?
description: A number is chosen and ten different expressions are made for it using adding, taking away, multiplying, dividing and a bracket. Each one is checked to have the chosen value.
teaching_notes: One idea: the same number can be reached by many different expressions, using any of the four operations and brackets. Watch for students who write the same expression ten times with the numbers swapped.

video_script.why: The child writes ten different expressions for one chosen number by using each operation and a bracket, and checks each value.
video_script.substitution: Choose any number and build expressions for it with adding, taking away, multiplying, dividing and brackets.
video_script.anchor: A chosen number card and ten empty lines for expressions
video_script.payoff_line: Ten expressions make twenty four, and other numbers work in the same way.

final_answer.spoken: ten expressions make twenty four, and other numbers work in the same way

never_show: an expression that does not have the value 24
video_script.design: A number card sits at the top of the board and ten lines are filled in groups. Each line is checked off against the number card at the end.

beats.on_screen: a small title card From your book; an empty number card and ten empty lines below it

marks.h1: the title card arrives: From your book
marks.h3: ten empty lines appear and glow

narration: <bookmark mark='h1'/>This is a question from your book about one number in many forms.
<bookmark mark='h2'/>We choose any number, and write ten different expressions with that value.
<bookmark mark='h3'/>How can we make ten expressions for the same number?

beats.on_screen: the empty number card and the ten lines stay on the board; Keeko sits at the corner of the board

marks.t1: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

narration: <bookmark mark='t1'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: four signs + − × ÷ and a bracket pair, each with an arrow pointing to the number card

marks.g1: the four signs appear with arrows to the number card
marks.g2: the bracket pair appears with an arrow to the number card

narration: <bookmark mark='g1'/>Adding, taking away, multiplying and dividing can all reach the same number.
<bookmark mark='g2'/>A bracket gives one more way.

marks.gv1: the words any number we choose are written

narration: <bookmark mark='gv1'/>Given, any number that we choose.

beats.on_screen: To find: ten different expressions with the value of that number

marks.fd1: the words ten different expressions are written

narration: <bookmark mark='fd1'/>We have to write ten different expressions with the value of that number.

marks.s11: 24 is written on the number card
marks.s12: 12 + 12 and 20 + 4 fill the first two lines
marks.s13: 34 − 10, 30 − 6 and 100 − 76 fill the next three lines

narration: <bookmark mark='s11'/>Step one, choose the number twenty four.
Adding and taking away give five expressions.
<bookmark mark='s12'/>Twelve plus twelve is twenty four, and twenty plus four is twenty four.
<bookmark mark='s13'/>Thirty four minus ten, thirty minus six and one hundred minus seventy six are also twenty four.

marks.s21: 4 × 6 and 8 × 3 fill the next two lines
marks.s22: 48 ÷ 2 and 72 ÷ 3 fill the next two lines

narration: <bookmark mark='s21'/>Step two, use multiplying and dividing.
Four times six and eight times three are twenty four.
<bookmark mark='s22'/>Forty eight divided by two, and seventy two divided by three, are twenty four too.

marks.s31: 5 + 7 is put in a bracket and becomes 12
marks.s32: 2 × 12 is written on the tenth line

narration: <bookmark mark='s31'/>Step three, use a bracket.
Five plus seven inside a bracket is twelve.
<bookmark mark='s32'/>Two times open bracket five plus seven close bracket is two times twelve.

beats.on_screen: check: each of the ten lines is worked out and meets the number card 24

marks.s41: the first five lines are worked out and each meets 24
marks.s42: the next four lines are worked out and each meets 24
marks.s43: the bracket line is worked out and meets 24

narration: <bookmark mark='s41'/>Step four, check all ten lines.
The first five are sums and differences, and each works out to twenty four.
<bookmark mark='s42'/>The next four are products and quotients, and each works out to twenty four.
<bookmark mark='s43'/>The bracket line is two times twelve, which is twenty four too.

beats.on_screen: Answer: answers vary; ten expressions for 24 are 12 + 12, 4 × 6, 48 ÷ 2, 34 − 10, 20 + 4, 30 − 6, 8 × 3, 100 − 76, 2 × (5 + 7) and 72 ÷ 3

marks.a1: the ten expressions are listed and each meets 24
marks.a2: the words answers vary are written below

narration: <bookmark mark='a1'/>Ten expressions make twenty four, and other numbers work in the same way.
<bookmark mark='a2'/>Any ten different expressions with the same value are a correct answer.
